description: A fact listed as missing while a real value for that exact key sits in facts is removed from the missing list; the recorded value wins and the contradiction is flagged.
why_it_exists: Validate Plan JSON seeds its missing list from the model's own raw.missing_facts and never prunes a key that IS present in facts, so a fact could be reported known and missing at the same time - blocking a matter over a fact it already holds.

input.facts_json: {"incident_description": "Rear quarter panel struck while the vehicle was parked and unattended.", "incident_datetime": "UNVERIFIED: unknown; discovered 2026-08-14 about 18:00 AWST; occurred while parked", "incident_location": "Level 2, Hay Street car park, Perth WA", "owner_present": "no", "driver_identity": "vehicle was unattended", "own_vehicle_registration": "9XYZ876", "damage_description": "Dent and paint transfer to the rear quarter panel."}

items.facts_json: {"incident_description": "Rear quarter panel struck while the vehicle was parked and unattended.", "incident_datetime": "UNVERIFIED: unknown; discovered 2026-08-14 about 18:00 AWST; occurred while parked", "incident_location": "Level 2, Hay Street car park, Perth WA", "owner_present": "no", "driver_identity": "vehicle was unattended", "own_vehicle_registration": "9XYZ876", "damage_description": "Dent and paint transfer to the rear quarter panel."}

assertions: A key is a contradiction only when it looks like a fact key (/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/) and facts holds a real, non-placeholder value for it.
Recorded facts win: the key is dropped from missing, and the matter proceeds.
PLANNER_CONTRADICTION is raised and requires_human_review is set - the contradiction is resolved in favour of proceeding but is never silent.
The owner summary names the contradicting keys and states that the recorded values were kept.
